description: One entry on the dock -- what it points at, its order (`idx`) and whether it is hidden. The same rows at all three layers: an app's fragment, the site's arrangement and one person's own are told apart by the parent `Dock`, never by the row. What an entry points at *is* its identity, so there is no stored key and no `type` column: exactly one of `module` and `workspace` is filled, and which one is filled is what kind of entry it is.

fields.description: The module this entry opens. Blank when the entry names a workspace instead.
fields.label: Module

fields.description: The workspace this entry opens -- how a companion app's page is pinned into a dock. Blank when the entry names a module instead.
fields.label: Workspace

fields.description: Kept in the row so an explicitly hidden entry stays hidden when its app later adds modules, instead of reappearing because it is simply absent.
fields.label: Hidden

name: Dock Item
